# OpenJev Multimodal

Open-source Jev-compatible SystemOne API for local text and image classification on Apple Silicon.
Not affiliated with TypeSafe; open-model predictions are not proprietary Jev outputs.

- [Quickstart](https://jev-skills.github.io/openjev-multimodal/guide)
- [API](https://jev-skills.github.io/openjev-multimodal/api)
- [Models](https://jev-skills.github.io/openjev-multimodal/models)
- [Benchmarks](https://jev-skills.github.io/openjev-multimodal/benchmarks)
- [Latency](https://jev-skills.github.io/openjev-multimodal/performance): server timing on every response; shared-prefix priming makes multi-question requests up to 60% faster
- [Tetris demo](https://jev-skills.github.io/openjev-multimodal/tetris): four local models play Tetris, one output token per two pieces; Qwen3.8-27B decides in 0.73 s with a cached state
- [中文文档](https://jev-skills.github.io/openjev-multimodal/zh/guide)
- [Source](https://github.com/jev-skills/openjev-multimodal)

POST /v1/systemone accepts model, state, questions and optional images (PNG/JPEG/WebP data URLs).
Question types: noul (P(true)), choice (argmax with complete probabilities), score (expected rubric index).
One output token per question. Probabilities are conditional on supplied labels; confidence is entropy concentration.
GitHub Pages hosts static documentation, not the inference API.
